title: Concept: SOAP fault carrying the server exception
description: A SOAP fault whose detail block repeats the server exception in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The fault detail names the class, the message and often the stack, which is the same information a debug page gives but inside a protocol response that clients log.
applicability: Deployments that render a SOAP fault whose detail block repeats the server exception into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The fault detail names the class, the message and often the stack, which is the same information a debug page gives but inside a protocol response that clients log.
